description: The figure presents two pie charts comparing the distribution of four outcome categories—Atomic Skill Fail, Correct, Reason Error, and Question Misunderstood—using a shared legend at the top; each pie contains 4 slices with percentage labels shown inside the segments. In the left pie, Atomic Skill Fail is the largest dark teal slice at about 68.0%, Correct is a medium blue-gray slice at about 12.0%, Reason Error is a lighter blue-gray slice at about 12.0%, and Question Misunderstood is a very light gray/white slice at about 8.0%. In the right pie, Correct is the largest medium blue-gray slice (approximately 55% by visual area, though no percentage label is visible on that slice), Reason Error is a lighter blue-gray slice labeled 21.0%, Question Misunderstood is a very light gray/white slice labeled 14.0%, and Atomic Skill Fail is a dark teal slice labeled 10.0%; no slices appear exploded or offset, and the slices do not appear strictly ordered by size around the circle.
